cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 gives a measured share of people with basic digital skills, from a survey.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 61: a programme shown in more than one location counts; national evidence is not needed): the State Department of ICT's DigiTruck trained 330 young people in Keiyo South (KEN-003, KEN-004), and Garissa County's programme with partners had over 700 enrolled in Garissa and Turkana (KEN-001), so stage 3.
